newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Schlumberger signs PDVSA technology contract.
newsitem.headline: Schlumberger signs PDVSA technology contract.

text.p: Schlumberger subsidiary Schlumberger-Geoquest has signed an information services agreement with Intesa, the information technology arm of Venezuela's state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA), PDVSA said in a statement on Thursday.
"Schlumberger-Geoquest's main responsibility will be managing and coordinating an integrated environment of data and specialised applications in exploration and production," the statement said.
The statement did not say what the contract was worth, but Claus Graf, PDVSA vice-president, said it would contribute to the company's efforts to cut costs and increase profitability.
